login.title: Omukutu gw'omunywani
login.welcome: Nitubaakira kugaruka! Taaha omu nkora kubaasa kutegyeka abeebembezi baawe.
login.heroTitle: Kura bizinesi yaawe ey'okuguza amaju n'eitaka na buri mwebembezi ou orikureeta
login.heroIntro: Omuryango gumwe gw’okuhandikisa bakasitoma n’abombeki, okurinda ekitiinisa ky’abeebembezi baawe kandi obakuratire kuhika aha kuhandiika.

register.title: Handika abarikwebembera omu bwire bukye
register.text: Heereza kasitoma waawe hamwe na purojekiti ei barikwenda.

protect.title: Okurinda emirundi ebiri
protect.text: Okwebembera kwawe nikuguma kuri okwawe kumara obwire bw’obukuumi, n’ahabw’ekyo tihaine ondiijo orikubaasa kushaba kasitoma niwe omwe.

track.title: Kuratirira buri idaara
track.text: Reeba embeera ya buri mwebembezi n’ebyafaayo bye byona, kuruga aha kubanza kuhika aha kuhandiika.

handover.title: Ekibanja aha kugura
handover.text: Kasitoma ku arikuhandiika, okwebembera nikuheebwa omwombeki iwe ohandiikirwe nk’omunywani w’entandikwa.

login.secure: Okutaaha omu simu - ebikwatiraine na bakasitoma baawe bigume biri eby'ekihama

signup.title: Okwehandikisa kw'omunywani wa Channel
signup.intro: Taho akawunti yaawe kutandika kwehandikisa n’okutegyeka abarikwebembera.
